name: Euro-area economy
summary: Euro-area GDP up 0.4% in Q3; ECB flags energy risks to growth
state: Eurostat's flash estimate on 30 Oct showed euro-area GDP up 0.4% in Q3, though French output contracted. The ECB warned on 29 Oct that energy prices pose downside risks to growth, and euro-area flash PMIs (23 Oct) showed expansion slowing. Neither stagnation nor a sub-50 composite PMI is confirmed as of 3 Nov.
for_you: Growth is holding up but slowing; higher energy costs are the main risk for jobs and incomes.
rubric_hit: Growth positive; no stagnation or sub-50 PMI

sources.title: Agence Europe — Euro-area GDP up 0.4% in Q3

why: The euro area is the UK's largest trading partner; stagnation there hits UK exports and European markets.
drivers: Energy prices, German industry, ECB policy, fiscal rules, China demand.

rubric.alert: Technical recession, or PMI < 45, or bond-spread fragmentation forcing ECB action.
rubric.normal: Positive GDP growth and composite PMI > 50.
